audit.every_tm_earliest_acquisition_and_compat: Complete base-game location catalogue added; compatibility verification pending

rows.where: Choose as your starter Pokémon.
rows.moves: Water Gun; Bite (Lv. 10); Bubble Beam (Lv. 15).
rows.moveWhere: Natural level-up progression. Water Gun is available from the beginning.
rows.itemWhere: Gift from a woman at a stall southeast of Vert Sector 2. Only one confirmed copy; treat it as a temporary item.

rows.where: Wild Zone 1; available when Main Mission 3 begins.
rows.moves: Peck; Quick Attack (Lv. 8); Ember (Lv. 12); Feather Dance (Lv. 16).
rows.moveWhere: Natural level-up progression. Feather Dance is a later upgrade and should not be assumed available immediately.
rows.itemWhere: Use an available temporary held item if one is obtained. Do not assume a second copy of Quick Claw.

rows.where: Evolves from Totodile at Level 18.
rows.moves: Water Gun; Bite; Bubble Beam (Lv. 15); Slash upon evolution; Aqua Jet (Lv. 21).
rows.moveWhere: Natural level-up progression. Slash is learned upon evolution.
rows.itemWhere: Side Mission 20, Berry Clever Plan, rewards Oran Berries ×10.

rows.where: Ralts is found in the garden area between tall buildings in Magenta Sector 7, during the day or night. Evolves into Kirlia at Level 20.
rows.moves: Confusion; Draining Kiss (Lv. 12); Psybeam (Lv. 18); Magical Leaf (Lv. 20).
rows.moveWhere: Natural level-up progression.
rows.itemWhere: Side Mission 21, involving a Spewpa at the Museum. Only one confirmed copy; replace it with Gardevoirite when available.

rows.where: Wild Zone 6; available after Main Mission 5.
rows.moves: Ember; Roar (Lv. 13); Bite (Lv. 16); Take Down (Lv. 24).
rows.moveWhere: Natural level-up progression. Do not list Snarl as a Houndour move; Snarl belongs to Houndoom.
rows.itemWhere: Use an Oran Berry from Side Mission 20 if one is available.

rows.where: Wild Zone 8; available after Main Mission 9.
rows.moves: Mud Shot; Metal Claw (Lv. 7); Sand Tomb (Lv. 13); Bulldoze (Lv. 18); Dig (Lv. 28).
rows.moveWhere: Natural level-up progression. Dig is a later upgrade.
rows.itemWhere: Side Mission 23, Underneath the Holovator.

rows.where: Croconaw evolves into Feraligatr at Level 30.
rows.moves: Water-type STAB move; Crunch upon evolution; Breaking Swipe (Lv. 26); strongest available coverage move.
rows.moveWhere: Crunch is learned upon evolution. Liquidation is a later upgrade at Level 40 or through TM076 when available.
rows.itemWhere: Equip only after obtaining Feraligite. Do not assume it is available at the beginning of this phase.

rows.where: Kirlia evolves into Gardevoir at Level 30.
rows.moves: Dazzling Gleam upon evolution; Calm Mind (Lv. 35); strongest available Psychic-type move.
rows.moveWhere: Dazzling Gleam is learned upon evolution. Psychic is learned at Level 38.
rows.itemWhere: Use the Wise Glasses from Side Mission 21 if available. Replace with Gardevoirite when obtained.

rows.where: Catch Riolu in the rooftop area of Magenta Sector 9 during daytime in sunny weather. Evolve through friendship.
rows.moves: Metal Claw (Lv. 8); Work Up (Lv. 16); Aura Sphere (Lucario Lv. 25); Bulldoze (Lv. 28).
rows.moveWhere: Aura Sphere is learned by Lucario at Level 25, not by Riolu. Use the move reminder if necessary.
rows.itemWhere: Side Mission 36. Use while raising Riolu's friendship, then replace it with Lucario's Mega Stone when available.

rows.where: Houndour evolves into Houndoom at Level 24.
rows.moves: Fire Fang (Lv. 28); Dark Pulse (Houndoom Lv. 34); strongest available Fire- and Dark-type attacks.
rows.moveWhere: Snarl is a Houndoom move, not a Houndour move. Flamethrower is learned at Level 44.
rows.itemWhere: Use an available Oran Berry temporarily. Replace it with Houndoominite when obtained.

rows.where: Drilbur evolves into Excadrill at Level 31.
rows.moves: Dig (Lv. 28); Rock Slide (Lv. 32); Swords Dance (Lv. 36); Drill Run (Lv. 40).
rows.moveWhere: Earthquake is learned at Level 46 or can be obtained through TM069 after reaching Research Level 34.
rows.itemWhere: Use the Soft Sand from Side Mission 23 if available.

rows.where: Continue using the evolved Kirlia line.
rows.moves: Dazzling Gleam; Psychic (Lv. 38); Calm Mind (Lv. 35); strongest available coverage move.
rows.moveWhere: Use natural level-up moves and only compatible TMs that have already been acquired. Check the TM Catalogue for acquisition requirements.
rows.itemWhere: Side Mission 35. Replace with Gardevoirite when available.

rows.where: Continue using Lucario after evolving Riolu through friendship.
rows.moves: Aura Sphere (Lv. 25); Bulldoze (Lv. 28); Metal Sound (Lv. 32, move reminder); Swords Dance (Lv. 35).
rows.moveWhere: Close Combat is a later level-up move at Level 54.
rows.itemWhere: Use Black Belt if obtained from Side Mission 58. Otherwise, retain Soothe Bell only if still needed for friendship before evolution.

rows.where: Continue using the evolved starter.
rows.moves: Crunch; Aqua Jet (Lv. 21); Breaking Swipe (Lv. 26); strongest available Water-type move.
rows.moveWhere: Liquidation is learned at Level 40. Do not assume it is available before then.
rows.itemWhere: Equip after obtaining Feraligite.

rows.where: Dratini is found on the rooftop of Restaurant Le Nah in Vert Sector 6 during the daytime. Evolves into Dragonair at Level 30.
rows.moves: Twister (Lv. 5); Thunder Wave (Lv. 10); Breaking Swipe (Lv. 20); Dragon Rush (Lv. 30).
rows.moveWhere: Natural level-up progression. Do not assign Dragonite-only moves before Dratini evolves into Dragonite.
rows.itemWhere: Use only if already obtained. Do not assume an early guaranteed copy.

rows.where: Continue using Feraligatr as the team's Water-type attacker.
rows.moves: Crunch; Aqua Jet; Liquidation (Lv. 40); Ice Fang if available.
rows.moveWhere: Liquidation is learned at Level 40. TM076 is an alternative after Wild Zone 16 becomes available following Main Mission 24.
rows.itemWhere: Equip after obtaining Feraligite.

rows.where: Continue using Gardevoir.
rows.moves: Psychic (Lv. 38); Dazzling Gleam; Mystical Fire (Lv. 44); Calm Mind (Lv. 35).
rows.moveWhere: Use natural level-up progression. Check the TM Catalogue for compatible alternatives and their unlock requirements.
rows.itemWhere: Equip after obtaining Gardevoirite.

rows.where: Continue using Lucario.
rows.moves: Aura Sphere; Swords Dance; Dragon Pulse (Lv. 38); strongest available Steel-type move.
rows.moveWhere: Close Combat is learned at Level 54. Do not assign it before the required level.
rows.itemWhere: Equip after obtaining Lucarionite.

rows.where: Continue using Feraligatr as the team's Water-type attacker.
rows.moves: Liquidation; Crunch; Ice Fang; Rock Slide.
rows.moveWhere: Liquidation is learned at Level 40 or obtained through TM076 after Wild Zone 16 opens. Check TM compatibility before using other TMs.
rows.itemWhere: Equip after obtaining Feraligite.

rows.where: Continue using Gardevoir as the special Psychic- and Fairy-type attacker.
rows.moves: Psychic; Moonblast; Mystical Fire; Calm Mind.
rows.moveWhere: Psychic is learned at Level 38 and Mystical Fire at Level 44. Verify the acquisition method for other moves before assigning them.
rows.itemWhere: Equip after obtaining Gardevoirite.

rows.where: Continue using Lucario as the Fighting- and Steel-type attacker.
rows.moves: Close Combat; Bullet Punch; Extreme Speed; Swords Dance.
rows.moveWhere: Close Combat is learned at Level 54. Extreme Speed is learned at Level 45. Confirm the source of other moves before assigning them.
rows.itemWhere: Equip after obtaining Lucarionite.

rows.where: Continue using Excadrill as the Ground- and Steel-type attacker.
rows.moves: Earthquake; Drill Run; Rock Slide; Swords Dance.
rows.moveWhere: Earthquake is learned at Level 46 or obtained through TM069 after Research Level 34.
rows.itemWhere: Use Soft Sand if it remains available and is not needed by another team member.

rows.where: Dragonair evolves into Dragonite at Level 55.
rows.moves: Outrage; Hurricane; Extreme Speed; Dragon Rush.
rows.moveWhere: Hurricane is learned upon evolution. Outrage and Extreme Speed require their respective level-up progression. Do not list Dragon Dance as a verified Z-A level-up move.
rows.itemWhere: Equip if obtained and available.

rows.where: Continue using Houndoom as the Fire- and Dark-type attacker.
rows.moves: Dark Pulse (Lv. 34); Flamethrower (Lv. 44); Overheat (Lv. 55); Nasty Plot.
rows.moveWhere: Use the listed level-up moves at their required levels. Nasty Plot may be obtained through its compatible TM after the required Research Level.
rows.itemWhere: Equip after obtaining Houndoominite.

rows.where: Mystery Gift distribution using password CELEBRATE30TH. Distribution period: 12 November 2026–7 January 2027.
rows.moves: Geomancy; Moonblast; Thunderbolt; Focus Blast.
rows.moveWhere: The distributed Xerneas is Level 100 and arrives with these moves.
rows.item: Choose an available utility or damage-boosting held item
rows.itemWhere: Use an item already obtained. Do not assume a specific held item is distributed with Xerneas.

rows.where: Retain the six-member main-game roster developed through Phase 6.
rows.moves: Use the Phase 6 movesets and apply upgrades only after their level, TM, or move-reminder requirements are met.
rows.moveWhere: Check the TM Catalogue for the exact acquisition method, Research Level, Mission unlock, and compatibility.
rows.item: Available Mega Stones and held items
rows.itemWhere: Use only stones and items already obtained. Do not assign DLC-exclusive items before the DLC unlocks.

rows.where: Begin the DLC content only after meeting its main-game progression requirements.
rows.moves: Retain the established movesets until DLC-specific moves or TMs are actually acquired.
rows.moveWhere: DLC-exclusive moves and TMs must be recorded separately from the base-game TM001–TM107 catalogue.
rows.itemWhere: Keep using acquired base-game items until the relevant DLC rewards become available.

rows.where: Hyperspace Mission 11, Hyperspace Lumiose Survey No. 6.
rows.moves: Use Darkrai's available Dark-type and coverage moves. Confirm the final moveset in-game before locking it into the build.
rows.moveWhere: Do not assume DLC-exclusive moves before their actual acquisition.
rows.itemWhere: Obtained after the Rogue Mega Darkrai encounter in Mission 11.

rows.where: Hyperspace Mission 13, A Ruby-Red Legend.
rows.moves: Use compatible Ground- and Fire-type attacks. Confirm the final moveset in-game.
rows.moveWhere: Use only moves already learned or obtained through compatible TMs.
rows.itemWhere: Obtained during Mission 13.

rows.where: Hyperspace Mission 14, A Sapphire-Blue Legend.
rows.moves: Use compatible Water-type attacks and available coverage moves. Confirm the final moveset in-game.
rows.moveWhere: Use only moves already learned or obtained through compatible TMs.
rows.itemWhere: Obtained during Mission 14.

rows.where: Hyperspace Mission 12, The Greatest Gift. This mission becomes available after completing Missions 13 and 14.
rows.moves: Use compatible Dragon- and Flying-type attacks. Confirm the final moveset in-game.
rows.moveWhere: Mega Evolution uses its special move requirement; do not assign a separate Mega Stone.
rows.itemWhere: Follow the special move requirement associated with Mega Rayquaza.

rows.where: Use the established Lucario. Unlock through Side Mission 197, Ultra-Hardcore Lucario Showdown!
rows.moves: Retain compatible Fighting- and Steel-type attacks. Confirm any form-specific move requirements in-game.
rows.moveWhere: Do not assume the Z form or its reward is available before completing the side mission.
rows.itemWhere: Reward from Side Mission 197.

rows.where: Project M special side-mission sequence. Exact mission order remains pending verification.
rows.moves: Use compatible Psychic-type attacks and available coverage moves. Confirm the final moveset in-game.
rows.moveWhere: Do not assign unverified DLC moves or assume the encounter is available at the start of Phase 8.
rows.itemWhere: Obtained through the Project M sequence.

rows.where: Build toward Primal Kyogre, Mega Mewtwo Y, Mega Lucario Z, Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, and Mega Darkrai as each becomes available.
rows.moves: Optimize each moveset using verified level-up moves, move reminders, and compatible TMs.
rows.moveWhere: Check acquisition and compatibility before assigning any move. DLC TMs 108–160 remain separate from the base-game catalogue.
rows.itemWhere: Use each Pokémon's actual Mega Stone, Orb, or special Mega Evolution requirement. Do not equip unavailable items early.

tmCatalogue.title: Base-Game TM Catalogue
tmCatalogue.description: TMs 001–107. Each TM is reusable. Acquisition requirements are listed separately from Pokémon compatibility.
